{{Short description|American mathematician}}
'''Frederick Bagemihl''' (June 25, 1920 – April 12, 2002)  was an American mathematician at [[University of Wisconsin&ndash;Milwaukee]]. He was a visiting scholar at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] from 1953 to 1955.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ias.edu/people/cos/users/fbagemihl01 |title=Bagemihl, Frederick {{!}} Institute for Advanced Study |access-date=2015-10-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151125095526/https://www.ias.edu/people/cos/users/fbagemihl01 |archive-date=2015-11-25 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
